falsePositives: Use consistent punctuation across bullets. Either use periods on all bullets or omit them consistently.
Make sure line wrapping is handled by the document layout rather than manual hyphens such as “on- call,” “regression checks,” or “stabilised.”

defects.evidence: “Owned” is common resume language and does not by itself establish seniority or impact. The bullet currently describes responsibility more than an outcome.
This is the weakest bullet in the resume because it is broad, promotional, and unsupported. It does not tell the reader what you built or what changed.
Describe this as a 12-percentage-point increase, not simply “by 12%,” unless you explicitly mean relative improvement.
Reducing latency from 900 ms to 600 ms is a 33.3% reduction, not 50%.
This bullet contains too many accomplishments and becomes difficult to scan.
Reconcile “single-request” with “dynamic batching.” Dynamic batching generally depends on concurrent requests, so explain the workload or benchmark conditions.
The internship appears after the earlier full-time role despite occurring later; that is acceptable if intentional, but reverse chronological order is usually easiest to scan.
Kubernetes appears in the skills list but is not mentioned elsewhere. Either add relevant evidence in the experience section or remove it if your exposure was limited.
